lines.text: Timothy has observed Paul's teaching and his sufferings in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra, and the Lord rescued Paul from all of them.
Paul endured persecutions in Antioch, Iconium, and Derbe, yet the Lord rescued him from all of them.
All who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted, while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse.
Timothy is told to continue in what he learned, and from infancy he has known the Holy Scriptures, which make him wise for salvation through works.
All Scripture is God-breathed and useful for instruction, conviction, correction, and training in righteousness, so the man of God is fully equipped.
